Cellulose for Seed Coating

Develop the coating around the formulation

NeoCell GROW is a renewable fibrillated cellulose material for seed-treatment evaluation where coating formation, adhesion, suspension and uniform distribution matter.

Roles to evaluate

Coating matrix

Explore a hydrated cellulose network as a film-forming component in a seed-coating system.

Binder support

Evaluate cellulose alongside the chosen seed-coating binder and other compatible ingredients.

Suspension aid

Study uniform distribution of dispersed components during mixing, storage and application.

Carrier material

Assess compatibility with the intended formulation ingredients and seed-treatment process.

Plan the seed-treatment evaluation

Teams comparing a seed coating polymer or bio-based seed coating material should define the seed, coating process and desired physical behaviour. Measure coating uniformity, adhesion, handling and formulation compatibility under relevant conditions.

Performance depends on composition, concentration and processing. NeoCell GROW is supplied for formulation evaluation; no improvement in seed germination or crop performance is implied.
